import importlib.metadata as m,importlib.util,json,platform,sys
import agentic_rag.models
names=['pydantic','apsw','markdown-it-py','tokenizers','torch','transformers','pytest','hatchling']
versions={}
for name in names:
 try:versions[name]=m.version(name)
 except m.PackageNotFoundError:versions[name]=None
dist=m.distribution('codeplus-agentic-rag')
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'platform':platform.platform(),
 'versions':versions,'module_path':agentic_rag.models.__file__,'distribution_origin':json.loads(dist.read_text('direct_url.json') or '{}'),
 'gpu_modules_loaded_by_core_import':[key for key in sys.modules if key in ('torch','transformers','pymilvus','codeplus')]}))
